user.title: Investec Programmable Banking
user.description: Enter the API credentials from Investec Online > Programmable Banking > Manage API keys. Tick sandbox to test with Investec's sandbox keys.

Variables: balance, live_balance, test_mode, accounts, transactions, spent_today, spent_cycle, days_to_payday, cycle_start, payday, today. The Investec Display page in the sidebar has a live preview, examples and your own variables.
